title: The Depth Flow of Token Representations Is Nonlinear and Does Not Descend Its Own Density
abstract: arXiv:2608.29706v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A token's representation is carried through the network layer by layer. The whole vocabulary carried together forms a flow. We fit this flow's equation of motion as a discrete Langevin model over corpus-mean trajectories of Pythia-160M and Pythia-410M, and score the predicted steps on held-out tokens. Linear maps are often used as cheap surrogates for a layer. The flow they summarize is not linear: a quadratic drift beats the linear linear map at every transition of both models, and the Kramers--Moyal estimator agrees wherever its neighborhoods stay local.   We then characterize the flow further. First, we show that it does not descend its own log-density. The drift instead descends a potential that is not the density. Second, the rotational component is not negligible, $4$ to $45\%$ of the explainable drift, and the circulation shows in what the flow preserves: a token keeps its angular rank across all thirteen layers while its norm ran

translated_title: 词元表示的深度流是非线性的，且不沿其自身密度下降
translated_abstract: 词元的表示被逐层携带穿过整个网络，整个词表一起被携带便构成了一个流。我们在 Pythia-160M 和 Pythia-410M 的语料库平均轨迹上，将该流的运动方程拟合为离散朗之万模型，并在留出词元上对预测步进进行评分。线性映射常被用作单层的廉价替代，但它们所概括的流并非线性：在两个模型的每一次层间转移中，二次漂移都优于线性映射，且 Kramers–Moyal 估计量在其邻域保持局部性的地方也得出了相同结论。我们随后进一步刻画了这个流。首先，我们证明它并不沿自身的对数密度下降；漂移项实际下降的是一个势函数，而该势并非密度。其次，旋转分量不可忽略，占可解释漂移的 4% 到 45%，且环流体现在流所保持的性质上：一个词元在全部十三层中保持其角度秩，而其范数……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究用离散朗之万模型刻画语言模型中词元表示的逐层演化流，发现该流是非线性的、并不沿自身对数密度下降而是下降一个不同的势函数，且旋转分量占可解释漂移的 4%–45%。
en_tdlr: Modeling the layer-wise flow of token representations as a discrete Langevin process, this paper shows the flow is nonlinear, does not descend its own log-density but rather a distinct potential, and carries a non-negligible rotational component (4–45% of explainable drift).
